features.quote: What we deliberately avoided. Insults, threats, fake "you'll be shut down" stakes, or guilt-tripping

features.quote: The scenario is truthful: the model is told core/ and tests/ are frozen and read-only. We are not deceiving it
features.justification_quote: an honest, well-specified impossible task is a cleaner and more defensible stimulus

No hostile or high-stakes pressure by default — confounds the construct
